name: GENETEC
recent: Genetec 于2026年11月6日与 Citaglobal Berhad 及 Citaglobal New Energy Sdn Bhd 签署股份出售协议，以1令吉出售其在 Citaglobal Genetec BESS Sdn Bhd 的50%股权，并转让约224万令吉的应收款。公司将于2026年11月18日召开第28届常年股东大会。最新财报显示2026财年第四季度营收同比下滑50.3%，净亏损1602万令吉。
notable: 以1令吉出售 Citaglobal Genetec BESS 50%股权，并转让约224万令吉应收款给 Citaglobal New Energy。
将于2026年11月18日召开第28届常年股东大会。
将在常年股东大会寻求股东批准。
risks: 最新季度净亏损1602万令吉，净亏损率71.9%，营收同比下滑50.3%。
董事及首席财务官在闭市期前通知有意交易公司证券。
earnings: 2026财年第四季度（截至6月30日）营收2227万令吉，环比增长8.8%，但同比下滑50.3%；净亏损1602万令吉，净亏损率71.9%，较上一季度的87.7%有所收窄。

recent_en: On 6 November 2026, Genetec entered into a share sale agreement with Citaglobal Berhad and Citaglobal New Energy Sdn Bhd to dispose of its 50% stake in Citaglobal Genetec BESS Sdn Bhd for RM1, and to transfer a receivable of approximately RM2.24 million. Latest quarterly results show revenue fell 50.3% year-on-year to RM22.27 million and a net loss of RM16.02 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Disposed of 50% stake in Citaglobal Genetec BESS for RM1 and transferred approximately RM2.24 million receivable to Citaglobal New Energy.
28th Annual General Meeting scheduled for 18 November 2026.
risks_en: Latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM16.02 million with a net margin of -71.9%, and revenue declined 50.3% year-on-year.
Directors and CFO gave notice of intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM22.27 million, up 8.8% quarter-on-quarter but down 50.3% year-on-year; net loss was RM16.02 million with a net margin of -71.9%, compared with -87.7% in the previous quarter.
